258397933_35dd76d6.text: Recent single cell transcriptome analyses have provided a comprehensive Sst-IN subtype census, a plausible molecular ground truth of neuronal identity whose links to specific functionality remain incomplete

258397933_9fa65065.text: Four mouse models based on single or combinatorial Cre- and Flp- expression differentiated functionally distinct subpopulations of CA1 hippocampal Sst-INs that largely tiled the morpho-functional parameter space of the Sst-INs superfamily

258397933_8f00c570.text: our results provide a framework to translate neuronal transcriptomic identity into discrete functional subtypes that capture the diverse specializations of hippocampal Sst-INs

258397933_7541617e.text: Recent transcriptome analyses have provided a comprehensive classification of interneuron subtypes, but the connections between molecular identities and specific functions are not yet fully understood

258397933_1d7c0a45.text: Functional investigation in transgenic animals revealed that hippocampal somatostatin-expressing interneurons (Sst-INs) can be divided into at least four subfamilies, each with distinct functions
